segmentation.text: If a laned roadway is restricted to one direction,
a person shall not stand or park a vehicle
upon the left-hand side of such one-way roadway
unless official traffic-control devices are erected permitting such standing or parking.

elements.justification: 'Roadway' is 'that portion of a highway which is improved and ordinarily used for vehicular traffic, exclusive of the shoulder' (DEF-NRS-484A-220); a roadway 'restricted to one direction' is st.one_way_roadway, 'roadway on which traffic is restricted to one direction', which refines st.roadway, whose exclusion (not the sidewalk) does not touch a roadway. 'Laned' is read as a lane (st.lane, 'a longitudinal strip of roadway for one line of vehicles'; not a stand-in for a half of the roadway, which is not how it is used here) lying on the public way (st.on_way, 'the public way (a highway region) a structure region lies on'; st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines') on which the one-way roadway lies: the relation ties the lanes to the roadway's way, never distance.

'Stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than temporarily ...' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): park is a kind of standing, so the two together are standing. drv.motion.parked denotes a road user 'at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration', and leaves out 'a halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out': with min_duration p.standing_min_duration, a halt longer than a passenger pick-up dwell is standing, as the mapping index reads 'No person shall stand or park a vehicle'. 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'a person ... a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.

'Upon ... such one-way roadway': the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') the same one-way roadway s1 selects, re-bound with s1's selection. 'The left-hand side' is read against the roadway's designated direction (st.lane_direction, 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in ... a roadway, one-way roadway'), never the vehicle's heading alone: among the curbs or edges (st.road_edge, 'curb or edge of the roadway') lying on the roadway's way (st.on_way, st.highway), the one nearest the subject lies on the left of that direction. Its side is read with prim.region_lateral_offset ('the signed lateral offset (m, left positive) of a structure region from a road user ... perpendicular to the road user's heading'), whose sign is turned into the roadway's frame by the sign of the dot product of the subject's heading (kin.heading, 'direction the body points') with the roadway's direction: a parked vehicle may face either way. No 'not a stand-in' clause applies: the offset is used as a side, not as occupancy.

'Official traffic-control device' is 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... placed or erected by a public authority ... for the purpose of regulating, warning or guiding traffic' (DEF-NRS-484A-145); a device 'permitting such standing or parking' is read through the devices of the vocabulary that permit it: a marked bay (st.parking_space, 'marked bay for standing or parking') the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies); a regulatory sign of code angle_parking (dev.regulatory_sign, 'a point regulation by catalogue code') or a zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign, a signed zone with its 'conditions attribute') that governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; st.travel_region) a region the subject occupies, with its posted conditions holding for the subject (prim.conditions_hold, 'the structured conditions of a device ... hold at the observation for a road user'). dev.regulatory_sign's exclusion (a sign is not a manoeuvre or a road feature) is respected: the sign is read as the permission it posts.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a one-way roadway r (st.one_way_roadway) lying on a highway h (st.on_way, st.highway) on which some lane (st.lane) also lies.
obligation: For every one-way roadway r the subject occupies, selected again as in the applicability (lying on a highway h on which a lane lies), it is not the case that all of the following hold at the observation: (1) the subject is parked (drv.motion.parked with speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance and min_duration p.standing_min_duration); (2) the subject is on the left-hand side of r: of the road edges (st.road_edge) lying on h, the one with the smallest absolute lateral offset from the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset) lies to the left of r's designated direction, that is its offset is positive where the dot product of the subject's heading (kin.heading) and r's direction (st.lane_direction) is positive, and negative where that dot product is negative; (3) no device permits standing or parking there: the subject's footprint overlaps no parking space (st.parking_space), and no regulatory sign of code angle_parking (dev.regulatory_sign) and no zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign) whose conditions hold for the subject (prim.conditions_hold) governs (dev.governs) a travel region the subject occupies.

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not ... park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever is at its controls.
That a device is official and 'erected' is read from its presence on the road: a marked bay or a posted sign present in the scene is presumed official.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car is at rest, for longer than the standing duration, against the left curb of a one-way roadway of two lanes, heading along the roadway's direction; the nearest road edge lies to its left; it overlaps no parking bay and no angle-parking or parking-restricted sign governs the roadway.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same car is at rest for as long against the right curb of the same one-way roadway: the nearest road edge lies to the right of the roadway's direction.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The car is at rest against a left curb of a two-way roadway (st.roadway that is not one-way): no one-way roadway is occupied.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe the roadway's designated direction, so which edge lies on the left-hand side is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The car is at rest at the left curb of the one-way roadway inside a marked parking bay.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The car halts at the left curb only for a moment shorter than the standing duration and moves off: it is not standing.

segmentation.text: When official traffic-control devices are erected at hazardous or congested places,
a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle
in any such designated place.

elements.justification: 'Official traffic-control device' is 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... placed or erected by a public authority ... for the purpose of regulating, warning or guiding traffic' (DEF-NRS-484A-145). The device erected at a hazardous place is dev.zone_sign of kind hazardous_place ('a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road'), a sign that begins a zone (its end attribute not set); the device erected at a congested place to keep it clear of halting vehicles is dev.regulatory_sign of code no_stopping ('a point regulation by catalogue code'). That the place is hazardous or congested is the authority's designation, evidenced by the sign; the sign is not read as the hazard it marks (dev.regulatory_sign: 'a warning sign is not the hazard it warns of'). The designation is in effect where the sign's posted conditions hold for the subject (prim.conditions_hold; dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now').

'Stop' when prohibited is 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device' (DEF-NRS-484A-260, whose own scope 'when prohibited' these words meet); 'stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): the three verbs together forbid a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance), as the mapping index reads 'shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle'. The definition's exclusions, which the concept's contract does not make, are carried beside it: a halt with another road user ahead in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane, 'a is ahead of / behind b in the same lane') within p.queue_halt_gap of the subject's body (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', not a centre distance) is a halt to avoid conflict with other traffic; a halt on a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls') by a stop sign (dev.stop_sign), a yield sign (dev.yield_sign), a traffic signal showing a red or yellow indication (dev.traffic_signal), a railway signal with flashing lights or a gate not up (dev.railway_signal_or_gate), or a police officer's stop indication (dev.human_direction role police_officer, indication stop) is a halt in compliance with a device or an officer. 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'a person ... a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.

'Any such designated place' is the place the s1 device designates: a travel region (st.travel_region) the device governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; not a stand-in for a position, and it is not used as one) and the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies).

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a travel region r (st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a designating device d whose conditions hold for the subject (prim.conditions_hold): a zone sign of kind hazardous_place that begins a zone (dev.zone_sign), or a regulatory sign of code no_stopping (dev.regulatory_sign).
obligation: Wherever the subject occupies a travel region governed by such a designating device (selected again as in the applicability), the subject is not halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), except a halt that is (a) to avoid conflict with other traffic: some other road user is ahead of the subject in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) with a gap between bodies (rel.surface_gap) at most p.queue_halt_gap; or (b) in compliance with a device or an officer: a travel region the subject occupies is governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign (dev.stop_sign), a yield sign (dev.yield_sign), a traffic signal displaying circular_red, circular_yellow, a red arrow, a yellow arrow or flashing_red (dev.traffic_signal), a railway signal or gate with lights flashing or gate not up (dev.railway_signal_or_gate), or a person in the role police_officer giving the indication stop (dev.human_direction).

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion: the duty binds the vehicle's conduct whoever is at its controls.

That the place has been designated hazardous or congested by an authority, and the device erected there, are read from the device's presence on the road: the sign is presumed official and its designation presumed.

'Other traffic' in the stop definition's exclusion is read as any road user ahead in the same lane: the conflict avoided is read as a halt in a queue behind it, and a halt for a conflict with a road user crossing the lane is not read.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car halts in a lane governed by a hazardous_place zone sign whose legend is unconditional; no road user is ahead of it in the lane and no stop sign, signal or officer governs the lane.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The car drives through the same lane without halting.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in a lane that no hazardous_place zone sign and no no-stopping sign governs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The car is in the governed lane with no road user ahead, but the source does not observe its speed, so whether it is halted is unknown.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in the governed lane behind another car ahead in the same lane, its gap within the queue gap.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: The car halts in a lane governed by a no-stopping sign where a traffic signal governing the lane displays circular_red.

segmentation.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle
for any purpose or period of time
except for the expeditious
loading or unloading of passengers
in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone
during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

elements.justification: 'Stop' when prohibited is 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device' (DEF-NRS-484A-260, whose own scope 'when prohibited' these words meet); 'stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): together a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance), as the mapping index reads 'shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle'. The definition's exclusions are carried beside it: a halt with another road user ahead in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane, 'a is ahead of / behind b in the same lane') within p.queue_halt_gap of the body (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', not a centre distance) avoids conflict with other traffic; a halt on a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal showing red or yellow, a railway signal flashing or a gate not up, or a police officer's stop indication (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.traffic_signal, dev.railway_signal_or_gate, dev.human_direction) complies with a device or an officer. 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

The purpose 'loading or unloading of passengers' is not observable and is read by the conduct it explains: during the halt (drv.motion.complete_halt) a door of the vehicle is open (sig.door_open, 'a door open; side in {traffic, curb}'), the act through which passengers board or alight. The passenger curb loading zone is 'reserved for the exclusive use of vehicles during the loading or unloading of passengers' (DEF-NRS-484B-033).

'Passenger curb loading zone' is 'an area adjacent to a curb or edge of a highway reserved for the exclusive use of vehicles during the loading or unloading of passengers' (DEF-NRS-484B-033): st.curb_zone of kind passenger_loading, 'a signed or marked length of curb', which the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)'). The marking is the evidence of the designation.

The hours of a curb zone are those its posting states: a zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign, whose 'conditions attribute' is 'a list of time windows ...'; 'a legend read with no restriction is the empty set (unconditional)') governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies); whether its hours hold now is prim.conditions_hold ('env.civil_time falls in one of its time windows'), never the sign itself (dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now').

operationalizations.convention: curbside passenger pick-up dwell: a halt counts as expeditious loading or unloading while it has not lasted as long as a passenger pick-up dwell at the curb, i.e. while the subject is not at rest at every observation of a window of length p.standing_min_duration behind the observation (drv.motion.parked)

residues.why: 'For any purpose or period of time' excludes no halt: every halt, whatever its purpose and length, is within the prohibition, so the duty is the same whether or not these words are read.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a curb zone z of kind passenger_loading (st.curb_zone), and the zone's regulations are effective: every zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign) that governs (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies has its conditions holding for the subject at the observation (prim.conditions_hold); where no such sign governs, the marked zone is read as effective at all hours.
obligation: Wherever the subject occupies such a zone with its regulations effective (selected again as in the applicability), the subject is not halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), except a halt that is (a) to avoid conflict with other traffic: some other road user is ahead of the subject in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) with a gap between bodies (rel.surface_gap) at most p.queue_halt_gap; or (b) in compliance with a device or an officer: a travel region the subject occupies is governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal displaying a red or yellow indication or flashing_red, a railway signal or gate with lights flashing or gate not up, or a person in the role police_officer giving the indication stop; or (c) expeditious loading or unloading of passengers: the subject is not parked with min_duration p.standing_min_duration (drv.motion.parked with p.halt_speed_tolerance), and at some observation of the same halt, before or after the observation, a door of the subject is open (sig.door_open): the subject has stayed halted since an observation at which it was halted with a door open, or stays halted until an observation at which it is halted with a door open.

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
The purpose of loading or unloading passengers is read by the conduct it explains: a door of the halted vehicle open during the halt.
'Marked as' a passenger curb loading zone is read from the presence of the curb zone of that kind on the road.
'Other traffic' in the stop definition's exclusion is read as any road user ahead in the same lane, the conflict avoided being a halt in a queue.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car halts inside a passenger_loading curb zone that no sign governs, for longer than the standing duration, no door open; no road user ahead and no stop control governs its lane.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A car halts in the zone, opens its curb-side door, and moves off before the standing duration has elapsed.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: A car halts at a curb where there is no curb zone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car halts in the zone briefly, shorter than the standing duration, and the source does not observe its doors.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: A car halts in the zone while a parking_restricted zone sign governing its lane posts hours that do not include the observation's time of day.

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A car halts in the zone behind another car ahead in the same lane, within the queue gap, doors closed.

segmentation.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle
for any purpose or length of time
other than for the expeditious
unloading and delivery or pickup and loading of materials
in any place marked as a freight curb loading zone
during hours when the provisions applicable to such zones are in effect.
The driver of a vehicle
may stop temporarily
at a place marked as a freight curb loading zone
for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading passengers,
when such stopping does not interfere with
any motor vehicle used for the transportation of materials
which is waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

elements.justification: 'Stop' when prohibited is 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device' (DEF-NRS-484A-260, the definition the table resolves for 'stopping' in this law); 'stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): together a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance). The definition's exclusions are carried beside it: a halt with another road user ahead in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) within p.queue_halt_gap of the body (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', not a centre distance) avoids conflict with other traffic; a halt on a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal showing red or yellow, a railway signal flashing or a gate not up, or a police officer's stop indication (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.traffic_signal, dev.railway_signal_or_gate, dev.human_direction) complies with a device or an officer. 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

The purpose 'unloading and delivery or pickup and loading of materials' is read by the conduct it explains: a halt (drv.motion.complete_halt) during which a door of the vehicle is open (sig.door_open, 'a door open'), made by a vehicle built or licensed to carry goods (ru.truck, 'motor vehicle for carrying goods, with a body built for that purpose'; ru.commercial_motor_vehicle, 'vehicle over the jurisdiction's commercial mass class or marked as commercially licensed'), which tells the loading of materials from the loading of passengers that s10 excepts on its own terms. The freight zone is 'for the exclusive use of vehicles during the loading or unloading of freight' (DEF-NRS-484B-023).

'Freight curb loading zone' is 'a space adjacent to a curb for the exclusive use of vehicles during the loading or unloading of freight' (DEF-NRS-484B-023): st.curb_zone of kind freight_loading, 'a signed or marked length of curb', which the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies). The marking is the evidence of the designation.

The hours of the zone are those its posting states: a zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign, with its 'conditions attribute ... a list of time windows'; an unrestricted legend is 'the empty set (unconditional)') governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies); whether its hours hold now is prim.conditions_hold, never the sign itself (dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now').

'Driver' is 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-080): a role, read through the vehicle's controlled motion; 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle. The driver is the subject's own vehicle.
The same freight_loading curb zone (st.curb_zone, 'a signed or marked length of curb') the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies), re-bound with the selection of s5.

The purpose and engagement 'in loading or unloading passengers' are read by the conduct: a door of the halted vehicle (drv.motion.complete_halt) open (sig.door_open, 'a door open') during the halt, the act through which passengers board or alight.

'Motor vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle ('every vehicle which is self-propelled but not operated upon rails'); a motor vehicle 'used for the transportation of materials' is the class whose contract is exactly that: ru.truck, 'motor vehicle for carrying goods, with a body built for that purpose', carried beside the aggregate, not in place of it.

'Waiting to enter or about to enter such zone' is read by the conduct: the goods vehicle does not overlap the zone (rel.occupies, st.curb_zone of kind freight_loading, the zone of s5) and is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt) with the ground distance from its body to the zone (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it') within p.zone_entry_wait_reach. The relation is the distance the words imply ('waiting to enter'), not a belonging.

operationalizations.convention: commercial loading zone time limit: a halt counts as expeditious loading or unloading of materials while it has not lasted as long as the thirty-minute limit common to commercial loading zones, i.e. while the subject is not at rest at every observation of a window of length p.commercial_loading_max_halt behind the observation (drv.motion.parked)

curbside passenger pick-up dwell: a stop counts as temporary while it has not lasted as long as a passenger pick-up dwell, i.e. while the subject is not at rest at every observation of a window of length p.standing_min_duration behind the observation (drv.motion.parked)

queueing at a curb space: a stop interferes with a goods vehicle where, at some observation of the stop so far, that vehicle stands halted outside the zone within one passenger-car length plus a queue spacing of it (p.zone_entry_wait_reach), the place a vehicle waits to take the space

residues.why: 'For any purpose or length of time' excludes no halt: every halt is within the prohibition whatever its purpose and length, so the duty is the same whether or not these words are read.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a curb zone z of kind freight_loading (st.curb_zone), and the zone's provisions are in effect: every zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign) that governs (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies has its conditions holding for the subject (prim.conditions_hold); where no such sign governs, the marked zone is read as in effect at all hours.
obligation: Wherever the subject occupies such a zone z in effect (selected again as in the applicability), the subject is not halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), except a halt that is (a) to avoid conflict with other traffic: some other road user is ahead of the subject in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) with a gap between bodies (rel.surface_gap) at most p.queue_halt_gap; or (b) in compliance with a device or an officer: a travel region the subject occupies is governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal displaying a red or yellow indication or flashing_red, a railway signal or gate with lights flashing or gate not up, or a person in the role police_officer giving the indication stop; or (c) expeditious loading of materials: the subject is a truck or a commercial motor vehicle (ru.truck or ru.commercial_motor_vehicle), it is not parked with min_duration p.commercial_loading_max_halt (drv.motion.parked), and a door of the subject is open (sig.door_open) at some observation of the same halt, before or after the observation; or (d) a temporary stop for passengers: the subject is not parked with min_duration p.standing_min_duration, a door of the subject is open at some observation of the same halt, before or after the observation, and at no observation of the halt up to the judged one is there a road user other than the subject that is a motor vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-130::motor_vehicle) and a truck (ru.truck), whose footprint does not overlap z, which is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt), and whose body's ground distance to z (st.region_geometry) is at most p.zone_entry_wait_reach.

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
'The driver of a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.

The loading or delivery of materials is read by the conduct it explains: a door open during the halt of a truck or a commercial motor vehicle; a delivery made from a passenger car is not told from a passenger pick-up and is judged under the passenger exception.
The purpose of and engagement in loading or unloading passengers are read by a door of the halted vehicle open during the halt.

'Waiting to enter or about to enter' is read by the conduct it leads to: a goods vehicle halted outside the zone within the waiting reach of it; one still moving toward the zone is not read as waiting.
'Marked as' a freight curb loading zone is read from the presence of the curb zone of that kind.

scenarios.narrative: A passenger car halts inside a freight_loading curb zone that no sign governs, for longer than the standing duration, doors closed; no road user ahead and no stop control governs its lane.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: A truck halts in the zone with its curb-side door open and moves off before the commercial loading duration has elapsed.

scenarios.name: idle

scenarios.name: blind

segmentation.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle
for any purpose or length of time
in any restricted parking zone
other than for the purpose to which parking in such zone is restricted,
except that a driver of a passenger vehicle
may stop temporarily
in such zone
for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of passengers
when such stopping does not interfere with
any vehicle which is waiting to enter or about to enter the zone
for the purpose of parking in accordance with the purpose to which parking is restricted.

elements.justification: 'Stop' when prohibited is 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device' (DEF-NRS-484A-260, the definition the table resolves for 'stopping' in this law); 'stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): together a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance). The definition's exclusions are carried beside it: a halt with another road user ahead in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) within p.queue_halt_gap of the body (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', not a centre distance) avoids conflict with other traffic; a halt on a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal showing red or yellow, a railway signal flashing or a gate not up, or a police officer's stop indication (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.traffic_signal, dev.railway_signal_or_gate, dev.human_direction) complies with a device or an officer. 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

A restricted parking zone is st.curb_zone of kind restricted_parking ('a signed or marked length of curb'), which the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)').

The purpose to which parking is restricted is the restriction the zone's posting states: a zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign, whose 'conditions attribute' carries 'a vehicle class' and time windows) governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies). A halt is for that purpose where the sign's conditions hold for the subject (prim.conditions_hold: 'any occupancy or class condition is met'); the sign is not read as the condition holding (dev.zone_sign is 'not a stand-in for whether the condition holds now').

'Driver' is 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-080), read through the vehicle's controlled motion. 'Passenger vehicle' has no posted definition: it is read as a vehicle (the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) not built to carry goods or to be drawn: not ru.truck ('motor vehicle for carrying goods, with a body built for that purpose') and not ru.trailer_or_combination ('vehicle drawn by another, or the combination'). The class atoms are carried beside the aggregate, never in place of it.
'In such zone': the same restricted_parking curb zone (st.curb_zone) the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies), re-bound with the selection of s3.

The purpose of and engagement 'in loading or unloading of passengers' are read by the conduct: a door of the halted vehicle (drv.motion.complete_halt) open (sig.door_open, 'a door open') during the halt.

'Any vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; 'waiting to enter or about to enter the zone' is read by the conduct: that vehicle does not overlap the zone (rel.occupies, st.curb_zone of s3) and is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt) with the ground distance from its body to the zone (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it') within p.zone_entry_wait_reach.

Parking 'in accordance with the purpose to which parking is restricted' is read, for the waiting vehicle, as the conditions of the parking_restricted zone sign (dev.zone_sign) governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies holding for that vehicle (prim.conditions_hold, 'any occupancy or class condition is met').

operationalizations.convention: curbside passenger pick-up dwell: a stop counts as temporary while it has not lasted as long as a passenger pick-up dwell, i.e. while the subject is not at rest at every observation of a window of length p.standing_min_duration behind the observation (drv.motion.parked)

queueing at a curb space: a stop interferes with a vehicle where, at some observation of the stop so far, that vehicle stands halted outside the zone within one passenger-car length plus a queue spacing of it (p.zone_entry_wait_reach), the place a vehicle waits to take the space

residues.why: 'For any purpose or length of time' excludes no halt: every halt is within the prohibition whatever its purpose and length, so the duty is the same whether or not these words are read.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a curb zone z of kind restricted_parking (st.curb_zone).
obligation: Wherever the subject occupies such a zone z (selected again as in the applicability), the subject is not halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), except a halt that is (a) to avoid conflict with other traffic: some other road user is ahead of the subject in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) with a gap between bodies (rel.surface_gap) at most p.queue_halt_gap; or (b) in compliance with a device or an officer: a travel region the subject occupies is governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal displaying a red or yellow indication or flashing_red, a railway signal or gate with lights flashing or gate not up, or a person in the role police_officer giving the indication stop; or (c) for the purpose to which parking is restricted: some zone sign of kind parking_restricted (dev.zone_sign) governing (dev.governs) a travel region the subject occupies has its conditions holding for the subject (prim.conditions_hold); or (d) a temporary stop of a passenger vehicle for passengers: the subject is neither a truck (ru.truck) nor a trailer or combination (ru.trailer_or_combination), it is not parked with min_duration p.standing_min_duration (drv.motion.parked), a door of the subject is open (sig.door_open) at some observation of the same halt, before or after the observation, and at no observation of the halt up to the judged one is there a vehicle other than the subject (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint does not overlap z, which is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt), whose body's ground distance to z (st.region_geometry) is at most p.zone_entry_wait_reach, and for which the conditions of such a parking_restricted zone sign hold (prim.conditions_hold).

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
'A driver of a passenger vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.

The purpose of a halt is read through the class, occupancy and time conditions of the zone's posted sign holding for the vehicle; a restriction to a purpose the sign's legend states as none of these is not read, and a halt outside the sign's posted hours is read as not for the restricted purpose.
The purpose of and engagement in loading or unloading passengers are read by a door of the halted vehicle open during the halt.
'Waiting to enter or about to enter' is read by a vehicle halted outside the zone within the waiting reach; one still moving toward the zone is not read as waiting.
The waiting vehicle's purpose of parking in accordance with the restriction is read by the posted sign's conditions holding for it.

segmentation.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle
other than a bus
in a bus stop,
or a taxicab
in a taxicab stand,
when such stop or stand has been officially designated and appropriately signed,
except that the driver of a passenger vehicle
may temporarily stop there
and for the purpose of and while actually engaged in
expeditiously
loading or unloading of passengers
when such stopping does not interfere with
any bus or taxicab
waiting to enter or about to enter such zone.

elements.justification: 'Stop' when prohibited is 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device' (DEF-NRS-484A-260, the definition the table resolves for 'stopping' in this law); 'stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not' (DEF-NRS-484A-250) and 'park' 'the standing of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-155): together a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance). The definition's exclusions are carried beside it: a halt with another road user ahead in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) within p.queue_halt_gap of the body (rel.surface_gap, 'distance between the nearest points of two bodies', not a centre distance) avoids conflict with other traffic; a halt on a travel region the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal showing red or yellow, a railway signal flashing or a gate not up, or a police officer's stop indication (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.traffic_signal, dev.railway_signal_or_gate, dev.human_direction) complies with a device or an officer. 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

'Bus' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus ('a vehicle owned by the State, a political subdivision or a private school or nursery, designed for carrying ... passengers and used for the transportation of persons, or a vehicle, other than a taxicab, designed and used for the transportation of persons for compensation'), claimed as one atom, never expanded.

A bus stop at the curb is st.curb_zone of kind bus_stop ('a signed or marked length of curb'), which the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (... curb zone ...)').

'Taxicab' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-270::taxicab ('a motor vehicle designed or constructed to accommodate and transport ... passengers, including the driver, and used to transport passengers for a charge or fee'), claimed as one atom.

'Taxicab stand' is 'a fixed area in a highway parallel and adjacent to the curb or edge of the highway and set aside for taxicabs to stand for passengers' (DEF-NRS-484B-067): st.curb_zone of kind taxicab_stand ('a signed or marked length of curb'), which the subject's footprint overlaps (rel.occupies).

That the stop or stand 'has been officially designated and appropriately signed' is its legal status, read from the feature's presence on the road: the curb zone of kind bus_stop or taxicab_stand the subject occupies (st.curb_zone, 'a signed or marked length of curb'; rel.occupies) is presumed designated and signed.

'Driver' is 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-080), read through the vehicle's controlled motion. 'Passenger vehicle' has no posted definition: it is read as a vehicle (the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) not built to carry goods or to be drawn: not ru.truck ('motor vehicle for carrying goods, with a body built for that purpose') and not ru.trailer_or_combination ('vehicle drawn by another, or the combination'), carried beside the aggregate.

'While actually engaged in' fixes the loading to the stop itself: the door of s11 is open at an observation of the same halt (drv.motion.complete_halt, 'at rest at the observation'); the purpose is read by that conduct.
The loading or unloading of passengers is read by the act through which passengers board or alight: a door of the vehicle open (sig.door_open, 'a door open; side in {traffic, curb}').
'Any bus or taxicab': the admitted aggregates DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus and DEF-NRS-484A-270::taxicab, each claimed as one atom.

'Waiting to enter or about to enter such zone' is read by the conduct: the bus or taxicab does not overlap the zone the subject occupies (rel.occupies, st.curb_zone) and is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt) with the ground distance from its body to the zone (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it') within p.zone_entry_wait_reach.

operationalizations.convention: curbside passenger pick-up dwell: a stop counts as temporary while it has not lasted as long as a passenger pick-up dwell, i.e. while the subject is not at rest at every observation of a window of length p.standing_min_duration behind the observation (drv.motion.parked)

curbside passenger pick-up dwell: loading or unloading counts as expeditious while the halt has not lasted as long as a passenger pick-up dwell (drv.motion.parked with min_duration p.standing_min_duration); the same bound as the temporary stop it qualifies

queueing at a curb space: a stop interferes with a bus or taxicab where, at some observation of the stop so far, it stands halted outside the zone within one passenger-car length plus a queue spacing of it (p.zone_entry_wait_reach), the place a vehicle waits to take the space

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a curb zone z (st.curb_zone) that is of kind bus_stop while the subject is not a bus (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-030::bus false), or of kind taxicab_stand while the subject is not a taxicab (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-270::taxicab false).
obligation: Wherever the subject occupies such a zone z (selected again as in the applicability, with its kind and the subject's class), the subject is not halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), except a halt that is (a) to avoid conflict with other traffic: some other road user is ahead of the subject in the same lane (rel.ahead_behind_in_lane) with a gap between bodies (rel.surface_gap) at most p.queue_halt_gap; or (b) in compliance with a device or an officer: a travel region the subject occupies is governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign, a yield sign, a traffic signal displaying a red or yellow indication or flashing_red, a railway signal or gate with lights flashing or gate not up, or a person in the role police_officer giving the indication stop; or (c) a temporary, expeditious stop of a passenger vehicle for passengers: the subject is neither a truck (ru.truck) nor a trailer or combination (ru.trailer_or_combination), it is not parked with min_duration p.standing_min_duration (drv.motion.parked), a door of the subject is open (sig.door_open) at some observation of the same halt, before or after the observation, and at no observation of the halt up to the judged one is there a road user other than the subject that is a bus or a taxicab (the two admitted aggregates), whose footprint does not overlap z, which is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt), and whose body's ground distance to z (st.region_geometry) is at most p.zone_entry_wait_reach.

narrowings.why: 'A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
'The driver of a passenger vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
Official designation and appropriate signing are read from the presence of the curb zone of kind bus_stop or taxicab_stand on the road.
The purpose of loading or unloading passengers is read by a door of the halted vehicle open during the halt.
'Waiting to enter or about to enter' is read by a bus or taxicab halted outside the zone within the waiting reach; one still moving toward the zone is not read as waiting.

segmentation.text: A vehicle
shall not be permitted to stand
unattended
upon any perceptible grade
without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.

elements.justification: 'Vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway, except ...'), claimed as one atom.

'Stand' is 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers' (DEF-NRS-484A-250): a halt, drv.motion.complete_halt ('at rest at the observation ... its speed at or below a tolerance', p.halt_speed_tolerance). The definition's exclusion of passenger receiving is not carried: the duty reads only a vehicle with no person in it (s3), which no passenger is being received into while it stays so. 'Shall not be permitted' is read on the vehicle's conduct, whoever is in charge of it.

'Unattended': no person is in or on the vehicle to attend it, ru.occupant_count, 'the number of persons in or on a vehicle (an integer attribute of a road user)', equal to none. A source that observes arrivals but not a total declares it absent, and the rule is then unknown.

'Upon any perceptible grade': the subject is on a highway (rel.occupies; st.highway, 'the entire public way between its boundary lines', which the words' 'side of the highway' names) at a place whose slope (st.grade, 'longitudinal slope of the roadway at a point'; not a stand-in for the place of a crest, which is not read) stands clear of zero: its magnitude exceeds p.grade_resolution. The words name the grade's presence, not a size: 'perceptible' is read as a slope the source resolves.

'Stopping the engine': kin.engine_running, 'the vehicle's engine or motor is running, so that propulsion is available', must be false; it is 'not a stand-in for motion or a halt', and the halt is read separately (s2). 'Setting the brake thereon' on an unattended vehicle is the parking brake: kin.parking_brake, 'the parking brake (hand brake) is set'; not a stand-in for the service brake or the brake lamp, neither of which is read, since no person presses a pedal in an unattended vehicle. 'Turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway': kin.steer_angle, 'front-wheel steering angle' (not a stand-in for a path or a manoeuvre, and it is read as the wheels' position only), turned beyond p.steer_angle_resolution toward the side on which the nearest curb or edge lies. The curb or side is the road edge (st.road_edge, 'curb or edge of the roadway') lying on the subject's highway (st.on_way, 'the public way a structure region lies on'; st.highway) nearest the subject, and its side is the sign of its lateral offset (prim.region_lateral_offset, 'the signed lateral offset (m, left positive) of a structure region from a road user ... perpendicular to the road user's heading').

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), with no person in or on it (ru.occupant_count equal to none), whose footprint overlaps (rel.occupies) a highway h (st.highway), and the magnitude of the grade at its place (st.grade) exceeds p.grade_resolution.
obligation: At every observation at which the applicability holds, with h selected again as there: the engine is not running (kin.engine_running false); the parking brake is set (kin.parking_brake); and the front wheels are turned toward the curb or side: of the road edges (st.road_edge) lying on h (st.on_way), the one with the smallest absolute lateral offset from the subject (prim.region_lateral_offset) gives the side, and the steering angle (kin.steer_angle) exceeds p.steer_angle_resolution in magnitude and has the sign of that offset, both read left-positive.

narrowings.why: 'Shall not be permitted to stand' is read on the vehicle's conduct: the duty binds the standing vehicle whoever is in charge of it.
'Effectively setting the brake' is read as the parking brake set while the vehicle stays at rest; the brake's holding force is not observed.

The curb or side of the highway is read as the road edge nearest the vehicle, and the steering angle's sign is read left-positive, as kin.yaw_rate and prim.region_lateral_offset are; the direction the wheels should point for an uphill or downhill grade is not distinguished, the words not distinguishing it.

scenarios.name: branch_2

segmentation.text: The Department of Transportation, and local authorities with the approval of the Department of Transportation, may designate dangerous highway grade crossings of railroads
and erect official traffic-control devices at such crossings directing a stop.
When such stop signs are erected
the driver of any vehicle
shall stop within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest track of such a grade crossing
and afterward may proceed only
upon exercising due care.

elements.justification: A 'highway grade crossing of a railroad' ('railroad' is 'a carrier of persons or property upon cars ... operated upon stationary rails', DEF-NRS-484A-200) is st.railway_crossing, 'level crossing of a railway with the roadway, and its nearest rail', lying on a highway (st.on_way, 'the public way a structure region lies on'; st.highway). The authority's designation of it as dangerous is its legal status, evidenced by the stop sign erected for it (s2, s3).

'Official traffic-control devices ... directing a stop' ('every sign, signal, marking and device ... placed or erected by a public authority or railroad', DEF-NRS-484A-145) are stop signs: dev.stop_sign, 'regulatory sign requiring a full halt'; its presence is the evidence that it is official.

'When such stop signs are erected': the stop sign governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; not a stand-in for a position, and the place of the halt is read from the crossing, not from the sign) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies) on its approach, and that region lies on the same highway as the crossing (st.on_way): the chain of relations ties the sign to 'such crossings'.

'Driver' is 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-080), a role read through the vehicle's controlled motion; 'any vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

'Stop' when required means 'complete cessation from movement' (DEF-NRS-484A-255, whose own scope 'when required' these words meet): drv.motion.complete_halt, whose contract quotes it, with p.halt_speed_tolerance. The place of the halt: the ground distance from the subject's body to the crossing (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it (zero when they overlap)'), the crossing being st.railway_crossing with 'its nearest rail', is at most the upper and at least the lower figure the span states (literals), and the subject's footprint does not yet overlap the crossing (rel.occupies). 'Such a grade crossing' is the crossing s1 to s3 select, re-bound with every relation that fixed it.

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle), and the judged observation is an entry of the subject into a railway crossing x (st.railway_crossing): its footprint overlaps x (rel.occupies) and did not at the previous observation, and at that previous observation the subject occupied a travel region r (st.travel_region) governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign (dev.stop_sign), where r and x lie on the same highway h (st.on_way, st.highway).
obligation: Duty of an act before an event (rule 4c). Event: the entry of the applicability, for the crossing x and the governed region r it selects. Act and place: at some observation of the search the subject is halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance), its footprint does not overlap x (rel.occupies), and the ground distance from its body to x (st.region_geometry) is at most the upper literal of s5 and at least its lower literal. Search: back from the observation before the entry, through observations at which the subject does not overlap x and its distance to x is at most the upper literal (the stopping zone). History bound: the search ends at the approach start, the last observation before the entry at which the subject does not overlap x and its distance to x exceeds the upper literal, or at the subject's previous exit from x (the observation at which it ceased to overlap x), the previous occurrence of the same event; nothing else ends it, not the start of the recording nor a first observation. Verdict: where the search finds the halt, the duty is met; where it reaches either end without the halt, the duty is violated; where it reaches the subject's first observation, inside the zone, with neither end found and no halt, the duty is unknown. A distance, an overlap or a speed unobserved at an observation of the search makes the search unknown from that point unless a halt in the zone was found nearer the entry. Whether the entry occurred is unknown where the previous observation does not show the subject's overlap with x, and whether the stop sign governs is unknown where governance of r is not observed.

narrowings.why: 'The driver of any vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
The designation of the crossing as dangerous by the Department or a local authority is read from the presence of a stop sign governing the approach to the crossing.
That the device is official and directs a stop is read from the presence of a stop sign.
The distance 'from the nearest track' is read as the distance from the vehicle's body to the crossing region, whose near boundary is its nearest rail.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car on a lane governed by a stop sign approaches a railway crossing on the same highway from beyond the upper figure and drives into it without halting.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The car halts at a distance from the crossing between the two figures, then drives into it.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The car drives into a railway crossing from a lane that no stop sign governs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The car halts somewhere on its approach and then enters the crossing, but the source maps no region outlines, so its distance to the crossing is unknown at every observation.

scenarios.name: history_boundary
scenarios.narrative: The recording begins with the car already moving inside the stopping zone, between the two figures from the crossing; it enters the crossing without a recorded halt; a halt before the recording cannot be excluded.
scenarios.boundary: the car's approach from the observation at which it was last farther than the upper figure from the crossing up to the start of the recording

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The car halts only closer to the crossing than the lower figure, then enters it.

segmentation.text: The Department of Transportation, and local authorities with the approval of the Department of Transportation, may designate dangerous highway grade crossings of railroads
and erect official traffic-control devices at such crossings directing a stop.
When such stop signs are erected
the driver of any vehicle
shall stop within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest track of such a grade crossing
and afterward may proceed only
upon exercising due care.

elements.justification: A 'highway grade crossing of a railroad' ('railroad' is 'a carrier of persons or property upon cars ... operated upon stationary rails', DEF-NRS-484A-200) is st.railway_crossing, 'level crossing of a railway with the roadway, and its nearest rail', lying on a highway (st.on_way, 'the public way a structure region lies on'; st.highway). The authority's designation of it as dangerous is evidenced by the stop sign erected for it.
'Official traffic-control devices ... directing a stop' (DEF-NRS-484A-145) are stop signs: dev.stop_sign, 'regulatory sign requiring a full halt'; its presence is the evidence that it is official.

'When such stop signs are erected': the stop sign governs (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls'; not a stand-in for a position) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies) on its approach, lying on the same highway as the crossing (st.on_way).

'Driver' is 'every person who drives or is in actual physical control of a vehicle' (DEF-NRS-484A-080), read through the vehicle's controlled motion; 'any vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle.

'Afterward' refers to the stop: 'complete cessation from movement' (DEF-NRS-484A-255), drv.motion.complete_halt, whose contract quotes it, with p.halt_speed_tolerance. The referent is carried in full: the halt itself, at the place the span states, not compliance with the stop rule. The place of that halt: the ground distance from the subject's body to the crossing (st.region_geometry, 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it'), st.railway_crossing with 'its nearest rail', between the lower and the upper figure the span states (literals), the footprint not yet overlapping the crossing (rel.occupies).

'Proceed' after the halt is the subject's entry into the crossing: its footprint comes to overlap (rel.occupies, 'a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region') the railway crossing (st.railway_crossing), and the duty runs while it occupies it.

operationalizations.convention: traffic-conflict technique: proceeding across the crossing with due care is read by its outcome: from the entry and while the vehicle occupies the crossing, no rail vehicle (ru.rail_vehicle) approaches it within the conflict horizon (prim.closest_approach_within with p.conflict_horizon) to a centre distance below the collision clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance), and the vehicle's body touches no road user (rel.contact)

applicability: The subject is a vehicle (ru.aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle) that has entered a railway crossing x (st.railway_crossing; its footprint overlaps x and did not at the previous observation) from a travel region r (st.travel_region) it occupied at the previous observation, governed (dev.governs) by a stop sign (dev.stop_sign), r and x lying on the same highway h (st.on_way, st.highway), and afterward: on that approach, searched back from the observation before the entry to the last observation at which it was farther than the upper literal of s5 from x or to its previous exit from x, it was halted (drv.motion.complete_halt with p.halt_speed_tolerance) at an observation at which it did not overlap x and its body's ground distance to x (st.region_geometry) lay between the lower and the upper literal of s5. The applicability holds at that entry and at every later observation while the subject occupies x without having left it; it is unknown where the search reaches the subject's first observation without a halt or either end.
obligation: At every observation at which the applicability holds: no rail vehicle (ru.rail_vehicle) has a closest approach to the subject within p.conflict_horizon (prim.closest_approach_within) at a centre distance below p.conflict_centre_clearance (prim.closest_approach_distance), and the subject is in contact (rel.contact) with no road user.

narrowings.why: 'The driver of any vehicle' is read on the vehicle's controlled motion.
The designation of the crossing as dangerous is read from the presence of a stop sign governing the approach to it.
That the device is official and directs a stop is read from the presence of a stop sign.

Due care, a standard about the driver's state of mind, is read only through the outcome of the crossing: no conflict with a rail vehicle and no contact with any road user while on the crossing; the rule is a surrogate and its verdicts are evidence, not a legal conclusion.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A car on a lane governed by a stop sign halts between the two figures from the crossing, then enters it while a train closes on it so that their closest approach within the conflict horizon lies below the clearance.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The car halts between the two figures, then enters and clears the crossing; no other road user is in the scene.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The car enters a railway crossing from a lane that no stop sign governs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The car halts between the two figures and enters the crossing; no train is present, a pedestrian stands on the crossing near its path, and the source does not observe contact.

param_proposals.source: speed resolution of the acquisition source (sensor or simulator specification)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: time-to-collision threshold of the traffic-conflict technique: a closest approach later than this is not a present danger of a crash
param_proposals.source: Hyden, The Swedish Traffic Conflict Technique (1987)

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_centre_clearance
param_proposals.convention: centre-to-centre distance at the closest approach below which the bodies of a passenger car and another road user are taken to collide or nearly collide: about a car's half-length plus half a body width
param_proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book design passenger car dimensions
